subject: literacy
concept: Comparing how two different authors approach a similar theme or topic
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts thematic elements from two different texts into a comparison chart
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a shared theme to the different way each of two texts explores it
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph comparing how two texts approach a similar theme differently

assessment.mastery_threshold: comparison identifies a genuine similarity and a genuine difference in approach, supported by evidence from both texts
misconception_flags: summarizes both texts separately without actually comparing their approaches to the shared theme

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
